location: trace.server.round_work[i] (existing server.schema, rounds, spans, objects, prepared unchanged)
meter_codes: optional array of uint16, one per objects row in same order; omitted only if no rows. code & 15 = result; (code >> 4) & 1 = called PrepareSnapshotViews; (code >> 5) & 3 = append_reason; (code >> 7) & 3 = actual_settle; remaining bits reserved zero
meter_retry_all: optional true when reserve/commit failure requeues all taken ids and returns without settleDeferrals; never counted as actual_settle
partition: one sparse meter_costs row per result per round. All are signed int64 nonnegative. object_ns = sum(cols 7..23); api_ns = sum(cols 11..21); profile_decision_ns includes PendingDirty(), cadence and optional m.markPending. preprocess includes first subj.mu wait, selectedFor and prepareSubscribersLocked. revision_copy includes clear and revision iteration. entity_callback_admission = dispatch->callback entry, not pure mutex wait. wrap_return includes existing dirty callback + deferred unlocks and possible snapshot flag. api_early_return captures a skipped API boundary (e.g. lock callback never entered). tail ends at original objEnd. No cost after objEnd or before objBegin charged to object; stage observer overhead is not subtracted. Never apportion class sums to individual calls as measured time.
semantics: policy_hold and commit_gate determined in original state.mu critical section with short circuit unchanged. pack_error set at real packer error even if error wraps a reserved sentinel; append_reason follows actual flush switch. success_* denotes Prepare, not final wire delivery or batch commit. force from rounds[i][5], not inferred from time. Contiguous pending episodes/endpoints can be replayed from (round,subject,result); distinguish intervening empty rounds, noPrepare and missing/uncalled objects from actual API nonpending results; absent subsequent visit is censored, not proof of terminal deletion.
